decision.note: Current Kew genus backbone accepts O. gilvescens, and modern specialist work supports a distinct widespread western/central Texas concept, but this pass did not lock three exact project target-zone counties. Keep as a morphology-rich HOLD rather than forcing O. phaeacantha synonymy from older ITIS treatments.

learner_guardrail: Do not create duplicate canonical taxa from parent names, synonyms, or stale infraspecific concepts. Current accepted concept and project counting unit control installation.
